newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen opening higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen opening higher.

text.p: U.S. stocks are expected to open higher on Monday, continuing last week's record-breaking run.
The Dow closed up about 71 points on Friday to 7782 while the Nasdaq composite closed 12 points higher at 1423.
The long bond gained 4/32, its yield dipping to 6.72 percent. The Standard & Poor's futures index was up 0.75 to 904.20.
Analysts said they saw no barriers to another record day ahead of Tuesday's Consumer Price Index (CPI) data for May.
